name: The Rune Vault
realm: Runes store power. Variables store values.
lesson:
A VARIABLE is a named box that holds a value. You must declare its TYPE:
    int    -> whole numbers      (42)
    double -> decimal numbers    (3.14)
    char   -> one character      ('A')  single quotes!
    bool   -> true or false
    std::string -> text          ("Merlin")  needs #include <string>
  'const' makes a rune unchangeable after it's set.

trial.prompt: Which type should store the number of spells known (e.g. 12)?
Which line is a VALID char?
trial.explain: chars use single quotes and hold exactly one character.

trial.prompt: Declare an int named gold with value 50. (Type the full line.)
trial.explain: int gold = 50;  (int gold{50}; also works - brace init!)

pool.prompt: What keyword makes a variable impossible to change?
pool.explain: const makes the compiler reject any later assignment.

boss.prompt: The Mimic tries to change a const. What happens?
boss.explain: Assigning to a const is a compile-time error.
Converting double to int truncates toward zero: 7.

spell.prompt: Declare an int named mana set to 42, then print it.
